name: mock-usage
description: WireMock stand-in for an A2A 1.0 agent that reports its token usage (usage/v1, ADR 0056; local development only). Every model call it says is a call report, one of them under a sub-agent step, and the task keeps its totals.

extensions.description: Reports the tokens of each model call and the task's totals.
Reports the steps of its work.

skills.name: Summarize
skills.description: Summarizes a subject with the help of a researcher, and says what each model call cost.
